prompt_text:
严格参考输入的冻结生产母图；同一张脸、同一头盔和红色冠饰、同一铁灰与青铜甲胄、同一罗马裙甲、同一材质配色、人体比例、姿态与朝右方向。仅允许 REMOVE / INPAINT / COMPLETE；严禁 REDESIGN / RESTYLE。透明背景，无新增对象，无文字，无投影。输出为原始 1024×1536 画布，人物每个原有地标坐标不变，不移动、不缩放、不裁切。输入二是区域参考：白色允许编辑，黑色必须保留。它不是输出内容。未遮挡像素必须尽可能逐像素保持。

只移除手中的完整短剑，包括剑刃、护手、露出的剑柄和配重。保留现有握剑拳头及手指形状。补全剑后原本被遮挡的罗马裙甲、红布、大腿和必要腿甲边缘。短剑尖端下方本来无人体的部分保持透明，不要新增身体轮廓。不要改变姿态、手、甲胄、脸、头盔或披风。
model_note: Backend model not exposed by tool; not asserted to be Image 2.5.
mask_enforcement: Deterministic composite after reference-guided image edit; raw output retained.
matte_review_note: Only sword pixels sampled. Actual inner-leg gap traced; pale neutral checker pixels excluded only inside that gap ROI. No generic white/gray removal from armor.
actual_tool_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the only edit target: frozen Roman guard with shield already removed. Image 2 is a white=edit / black=protect region guide ONLY. Remove ONLY the entire gladius sword including blade, brass guard, visible pommel and handle pieces. Complete the existing skirt armor, red underlining, thigh and tiny knee armor edge that were hidden by it. Preserve the gripping left-of-image fist EXACTLY, at its original coordinates; do not open it or change fingers. Where the tip previously crossed empty space between legs, restore transparency. Keep the cloak intact. Never change any other visible pixel, face, helmet, crest, shoulder, armor design, colors, lighting, human proportions, stance, feet, other fist. Strict REMOVE / INPAINT / COMPLETE only, no redesign or restyle or full-character regeneration. Same full 1024x1536 canvas, no crop, translation or scaling. Return true RGBA transparency; do NOT paint a checkerboard pattern, solid black or any background. Output only the edited character, without the mask.
